name: ACK3 Crisis Simulator Training (CST™)
description: Commercial gamified crisis simulation platform for training organizational crisis management teams. Combines game mechanics with realistic scenario design for decision-making training under uncertainty and time pressure. Supports multi-player team exercises with real-time facilitator control and scenario injection.
domain: crisis management, organizational resilience, team training
reputation: established European commercial platform used by public sector and corporate organizations
notes: Commercial platform. Gamification elements include scoring, time-based challenges, and team competition. Supports both tabletop and digital exercise formats. EU-based company.
